Increased plasma-doxorubicin con- centrations and myelotoxicity have occurred when ciclosporin was used to modulate tumour resistance.1 Severe neurological toxicity occurred in another patient given doxorubicin after long- term ciclosporin therapy.2 It has been suggested that the use of ciclosporin or its analogues (see Antineoplastics, above for the effect of valspodar) to modulate doxorubicin resistance should be undertaken with caution.3 1.
